specButton.text:
Button

specCategoryChip.text:
CategoryChip

specCategoryEditorSheet.text:
CategoryEditorSheet
Canvas-only composite: Sheet + FieldInput + Buttons in the category editor
Props: mode add | edit · name · error none | empty | duplicate · lang · href (canvas)
Uses: FieldInput (error), Button primary + secondary (Delete, edit only)
Tokens: canvas, text, radius-lg, type-title
Code: features/categories/CategoryEditorSheet.tsx

specCategorySheet.text:
CategorySheet
Canvas-only composite: code Sheet + category options in TransactionForm
Props: kind expense | income · selected (category key) · lang · href
Uses: CategoryChip × N (wrapping rows, × deletes) + add chip, Button primary
Chips scroll past half the screen height; Done stays visible
Props also: categories some | none (canvas tweak; none = only the + chip)
Tokens: canvas, text, radius-lg, type-title
Code: components/Sheet.tsx, features/transaction-form/components/TransactionForm.tsx
Contract: docs/design/components.json
